live_note: Day four, evening: a quiet Saturday. Nothing new since midday: no organization confirmed breached by name, CISA's catalog (opened directly again at 18:40 ET) still has no PHP entry, php.net has had no release since Oct 21, and no vendor or agency published anything new this afternoon. The one account of a successful intrusion remains Unit 42's: an unnamed European government entity where an attacker it judges to be an AI agent had password hashes and multi-factor secrets within two hours. TechCrunch's claim that Trail of Bits has also confirmed compromises rests on an X post by its CEO that this run could not open. Reuters' evening read: seven experts expect weeks like this one for years; Cloudflare's CEO says he knows of more severe AI-found flaws in other critical software.
